pkgmetadata.longdescription:
A VA-API implementation backed by NVIDIA's NVDEC, letting native arm64 applications hardware-decode video on the GB10. Identical to the ::gentoo package apart from the ~arm64 keyword, which ::gentoo has never set even though the source is arch-neutral and the aarch64 NVIDIA driver ships the libnvcuvid.so it needs.
Note this does not help x86 guests running under app-emulation/fex: FEX provides no libva or libnvcuvid thunk, so the Steam client's Chromium webhelper cannot reach this driver and must keep hardware video decoding turned off.
